title.en: A 5 or 7 m³/h Hydraulic Sprayer Is Not a Trailer-Pump Order
title.zh: 5 或 7 m³/h 的液压喷涂机不是拖泵订单

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints a 380 V hydraulic sprayer at 5 m³/h and a high-flow hydraulic sprayer at 7 m³/h. Both list particle ≤8 mm. They are not Electric 15 or Diesel 30.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印有 380 V 液压喷涂机 5 m³/h，以及大流量液压喷涂机 7 m³/h。两者都写粒径 ≤8 mm。它们不是电动15或柴油30。

h1.en: Order the Hydraulic Sprayer by the Printed Cubic Metres
h1.zh: 按印出的立方米订液压喷涂机

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai separates two hydraulic spraying pages. The 5 m³/h machine prints 380 V, 7.5/9 kW dual motors, 8 MPa, 100 m / 50 m and hose 38/51 mm. The high-flow machine prints 380 V, 11/15 kW, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa and 150 m / 70 m. Particle size on the selection note for these rows is ≤8 mm. A buyer who needs 5 m³/h of concrete through a trailer should open a trailer page instead, because these sheets are sprayers and are quote-only.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把两张液压喷涂页分开。5 m³/h 那台印 380 V、双电机 7.5/9 kW、8 MPa、100 m / 50 m、软管 38/51 mm。大流量那台印 380 V、11/15 kW、7 m³/h、8 MPa、150 m / 70 m。选型说明里这些行的粒径是 ≤8 mm。如果要的是拖泵输送 5 m³/h 混凝土，应打开拖泵页，因为这两张表是喷涂机，并且只询价。

body.en: [/en/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/](/en/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/). The 5 m³/h path is the hydraulic concrete spraying machine without the high-flow name.
body.zh: [/zh/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/](/zh/products/high-flow-hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine/)。5 m³/h 的路径是不带大流量名称的液压混凝土喷涂机。

body.en: Both hydraulic pages print 380 V. That is a sprayer cell. It still does not become the voltage of Electric 40, which does not print a voltage cell.
body.zh: 两张液压页都印 380 V。这是喷涂机的格子。它仍然不会变成电动40的电压，电动40没有印电压格。

body.en: Name the path, ≤8 mm or your particle size, and that the site can or cannot supply the printed motors. Contact [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). No numeric price is printed.
body.zh: 写明路径、≤8 mm 或你的粒径，以及现场能否供给所印电机。联系 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。没有印数字价格。

question.en: Is 5 m³/h the diesel concrete sprayer?
question.zh: 5 m³/h 是柴油混凝土喷涂机吗？

answer.en: The diesel concrete sprayer also prints 5 m³/h, but on 28/32 HP with particle ≤6 mm and 80 m / 40 m. It is a different page.
answer.zh: 柴油混凝土喷涂机也印 5 m³/h，但是 28/32 HP、粒径 ≤6 mm、80 m / 40 m。是另一页。

answer.en: No. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h as a trailer pump.
answer.zh: 不是。电动15作为拖泵印的是 8–10 m³/h。

question.en: Do I order both hydraulic pages?

answer.en: Order the one whose output and motor you are matching.
answer.zh: 订你正在对照其输送量和电机的那一张。
